text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—The "100-Idol Battle☆ Idol Fest" is about 
to begin! Representing all Umadols, Falco 
is here too~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, ohh!? Waaah, you actually came to 
watch! Thank you so much~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see☆ That means you're already a 
huge fan of Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco is going to properly convey how 
amazing Umadols are! So... watch over me, 
okay☆

Watching the event from the back, I waited 
for Smart Falcon to make her appearance...

text_block_list.name: Idol Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's this next "Umadol" thing...? 
Isn't she an idol? Do you know anything?

text_block_list.name: Idol Fan B
text_block_list.text:
No clue. First time hearing about it... 
Guess we'll just have to wait and see.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —There is no need to worry if it is her.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Because I have faith in her. In the 
"radiance" that an Umadol possesses—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
~♪ Singing, dancing, and sprinting with 
all her might! Everyone's Umadol, Smart 
Falcon!

text_block_list.name: Idol Fans
text_block_list.text: Uma... dol...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right, let me explain~☆ An Umadol is a 
brand new definition of an idol☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Running in races, and singing on the 
Winning Live stage! Spreading tremendous 
sparkle and bringing hope to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I poured all of my feelings into this next 
song! Please listen!

And then, the music began to play... but 
an immediate change washed over the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Idol Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? W-What is this...? Something is 
transmitting straight into my brain—

text_block_list.name: Idol Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Is this... a racetrack...? —It's a Winning 
Live!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone~! Can you hear me? Is it 
reaching you? Falco loves Umadols! I love 
them so, so much!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(Running on the track, and standing on the 
stage won at the end. I love Umadols who 
sparkle and shine!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(The Umadols Falco loves so much, I want 
everyone to love them too! May Falco's 
feelings reach you! Reach them~~!)

text_block_list.name: Idol Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I feel it. It's really getting 
through to me. Her earnest feelings of 
wanting to shine with everything she's 
got...!

text_block_list.name: Idol Fan B
text_block_list.text:
There's only one thing to do with this... 
wave the penlight! Uoooooooooohhhh!!

It seemed Smart Falcon's feelings had 
successfully reached the idol fans.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, everyone, for listening 
to my song!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Did you get to learn about Umadols? I'd be 
so happy if this turned into a wonderful 
encounter!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Where an Umadol shines the brightest is on 
the Winning Live stage! Please come watch 
the races by all means!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, preferably on dirt tracks! Falco runs 
both powerfully and cutely there☆

text_block_list.name: Idol Fans
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... We can see something even more 
amazing than this?! Let's head to the 
races... straight to the live venue!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Striking the hearts of those who behold 
her— Sie ist das Umadol.
